decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1302/PL/01, 1302/PL/02 and site location plan. Received: 19th February 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 7 Malthouse Drive, Feltham and should not be used as a separate residential unit.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to the rear of the house.
